request: Build a small Jac web app for a kanban board. Columns hold ordered cards and may have a work-in-progress limit. Users drag a card to a new position in its column or to a position in another column, or move it with the arrow keys. Card order is stored and survives a reload.
acceptance: Moving the card at index 0 to index 2 in a column [a,b,c,d] gives [b,c,a,d].
Dropping into a column already at its limit is rejected and the card stays where it was.
Moving left from the first column does nothing; a target index past the end puts the card last.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
